en.t: If only I had known this day would come...

units.source_text: 说到这里已经气息奄奄，想继续说下去，

en.t: By the time she had said this, her breath was already failing, and though she wanted to go on speaking,

units.source_text: 只觉困疲不堪，痛苦难当了。

en.t: she felt only unbearable exhaustion and pain beyond endurance.

units.source_text: 皇上意欲将她留住在此，守视病状。

en.t: The Emperor wished to keep her there and watch over her illness.

units.source_text: 可是左右奏道：“那边祈祷今日开始，高僧都已请到，

en.t: But the attendants reported, "The prayers over there begin today, and the eminent monks have already been summoned,

units.source_text: 定于今晚启忏……”他们催促皇上动身。

en.t: with the penitential rites set to begin tonight..." They urged the Emperor to depart.

units.source_text: 皇上无可奈何，只得准许更衣出宫回娘家去。

en.t: The Emperor had no choice and could only permit the lady-in-waiting to leave the palace and return to her family home.
